items.title: Hunger rises to 22.6% in Q3 – SWS
items.description: More Filipinos experienced involuntary hunger in the third quarter of the year, according to a Social Weather Stations survey.

items.title: COA flags Sandiganbayan justices’ foreign trips
items.description: The Sandiganbayan was called out for failing to justify with proper documentation its expenses related to overseas trips of its justices and personnel, as well as organizing events in four-star and five-star venues across the country.

items.title: NBI tags 10 persons of interest in Laos drug haul
items.description: The National Bureau of Investigation has identified 10 persons and entities of interest in the seizure of 512 kilograms of suspected shabu in Laos, which authorities believe was intended for shipment to the Philippines.

items.title: VP Sara told: Stop playing victim
items.description: As her legal team prepares to take its turn in presenting her side in the impeachment trial, Vice President Sara Duterte should focus on building up her defense instead of portraying herself as a victim, private prosecutor Lorna Kapunan said yesterday.

items.title: Government rolls out water filters amid ‘super’ El Niño
items.description: The government will start distributing free portable water filtration kits to communities next week to ensure adequate supply of potable water amid a looming super El Niño, Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian announced yesterday.

items.title: ‘House realigned P206 billion  in 2027 national budget’

items.title: Duterte defense wants fewer witnesses,  evidence
items.description: The defense team of former president Rodrigo Duterte is not satisfied with the prosecution’s efforts to shorten its list of evidence and witnesses in his upcoming trial for crimes against humanitbefore the International Criminal Court.

items.title: Pinoys trust journalists over vloggers – survey
items.description: Despite an expanded information environment, a survey on Tuesday found that journalists remain Filipinos’ main source of news.

items.title: Legarda extends leave anew

items.title: VP to House prosecutors: Where’s the evidence?
